summary: Iteration 5 tested Share Trip Link, Driver Reward Badges with priority offers, presence location and the ERP Live Map, on both backend and frontend. Backend: 19 new pytest tests pass, and the 21 iteration-4 regression tests pass after one test-data fix (40/40). Frontend (375x667 web preview): every requested flow works. Customer share card: WhatsApp opens wa.me with a /live/{token} link, Copy link puts the URL on the clipboard, the 'Link active' label and Stop sharing work. Public /live/{token} page works without login: map, driver card, waiting state, ended state and an error for invalid links. Map tiles now load through /api/tiles (all 200) and show the OSM credit with no CARTO watermark. Driver: badge card, priority offer label (none on direct offers), presence location card (posts /driver/location), my-badge and next-badge in profile. ERP: Dispatch Live map button, More > Live driver map, city chips, counts and map, booking detail > nearest drivers > Offer job (toast shown, then goes back). ERP ratings badges and the customer driver badge both show. No red screens. Issues found are logic and UX gaps, not crashes.

minor.issue: on_trip is worked out from ANY booking in ACCEPTED/DRIVER_ARRIVED/IN_PROGRESS, including ACCEPTED bookings days or years away (e.g. PRJ-3YB57793 on 2030-01-01). A driver who is free now shows as 'On trip' (grey), and the dispatch map ranks them last. Limit on_trip to DRIVER_ARRIVED/IN_PROGRESS, or to ACCEPTED trips whose booking_window covers now (or starts within about 1-2 h). If the driver has several such bookings, 'trip' is just whichever one was read last. Reference: tracking_routes.py:307-319

Gold gives no extra reward over Top Rated: both get visible_at=now. MyRatings next_badge still says 'to unlock priority offers' to a driver who already has them. Either give Gold a real perk (e.g. a longer head start) or change the copy. Reference: logic.py:177

Drivers without a badge get no push notification when their delayed offer becomes visible 5 min later (only badge holders get 'Priority booking offer'). They only see it if they reopen or poll the offers list. Reference: logic.py:190

1) The average is rounded to 2 decimals before the badge check, so a true average of 4.4951 counts as 4.5 and earns Top Rated. /driver/reviews next_badge uses the exact average, so the two can disagree. 2) On startup every approved driver with zero reviews gets rating=None, which overwrites any seeded or imported rating. Reference: logic.py:34-38

Privacy is fine: no phones, OTP, ids or address text. Note that pickup/destination are exact geocoded coordinates, so the family can place the pickup precisely. This is acceptable for the safety use case; just a note.

ui_bugs.issue: On web, Linking.openURL(wa.me) opens WhatsApp in the SAME tab, so the customer leaves the app (seen: the page went to api.whatsapp.com). onChange() runs after the page has already left. On web, use window.open(url, '_blank') instead.

ui_bugs.component: ERP booking detail after Live map 'Offer job'
ui_bugs.issue: router.back() returns to the booking detail without refetching. After the offer the screen still shows 'Confirmed · Assigning' and the Offer button, while the backend status is ASSIGNED. Invalidate the admin booking query before going back.
The ErrorView title reads 'Something went wrong' for a link that was turned off or is invalid. A friendlier title would be 'Link not available'.

design_issues.screen: Customer booking detail / ERP live map
issues: Small buttons share-trip-other, share-trip-stop, live-driver-call/offer/profile and dispatch-live-map-button are 40px tall, below the 44px minimum touch target
Live map city chips: the default selected city (Mumbai) is scrolled off-screen at 375px. Scroll the selected chip into view or put the default first
Live map with a single marker zooms in very far (street level), which gives little context for dispatch. Consider a maximum zoom of about 13

action_items: MEDIUM: live-drivers on_trip should only count trips that are happening now (DRIVER_ARRIVED/IN_PROGRESS, or ACCEPTED within the booking window). Future ACCEPTED bookings currently mark a free driver as 'On trip' (tracking_routes.py:307)
MEDIUM: ShareTrip on web: open wa.me in a new tab (window.open(url,'_blank')) so the app is not replaced
LOW: ERP live-map offer: invalidate the admin booking query before router.back()
LOW: Give Gold a real extra perk, or fix the next_badge copy 'to unlock priority offers' for drivers who are already Top Rated
LOW: Notify drivers without a badge when their delayed offer becomes visible (or tell them offers may appear up to 5 min later)
LOW: refresh_driver_badge: check the badge against the unrounded average; don't set rating=None for drivers with zero reviews on startup
LOW: Make small buttons at least 44px tall; on the public page, title the invalid-link state 'Link not available'
critical_code_review_comments: The public share endpoint correctly whitelists fields (no phone/OTP/address). The token is secrets.token_urlsafe(12). DELETE removes the token, and sharing again creates a new one.
accept_offer correctly blocks acceptance before visible_at. The offers list filters on visible_at <= now. Direct ERP assign offers have no visible_at, so they are not affected.
admin_routes.py is 909 lines; consider splitting it (more than 700 lines).
ShareTrip native link uses BACKEND_URL + /live/{token}. This only works while the website and the backend share a host; use a dedicated public web URL env for production.
Copy link on web shows the 'copied' toast even when navigator.clipboard is undefined (non-secure context).

Demo driver Ravi has a leftover IN_PROGRESS trip PRJ-8C3XBV45 dated 2026-10-29 10:00 and an ACCEPTED trip PRJ-3YB57793 (2030-01-01), so pick other date/times to avoid driver_conflict. Login for non-demo phones returns dev_code (preview).
rca_of_issue: Iteration-4 regression failures (12) were caused by test data, not the app: to_accepted() always booked tomorrow 10:00, which clashes with the demo driver's leftover IN_PROGRESS trip, so /assign returned 400 'conflicting assignment'. Fixed in the test with a random future date.
